appmixer e2e run <flowId> and read the ProcessE2EResults payload (a PASSED runner verdict alone is not proof).
Before running, replace the placeholder zone/dataset values listed under notes with the real ones on the account.

notes: Build-only run: the user pre-approved a run with no credentials. No appmixer test/publish/e2e-import/e2e-run command was executed and no HTTP call was made to Bright Data.
The two E2E flows were generated now so a later credentialed run can import and execute them unchanged.

Account-specific values baked into the flows and needing human confirmation before the first live run: Web Unlocker zone 'web_unlocker1', SERP zone 'serp_api1' (these are Bright Data's default zone names, not verified against a real account) and Web Scraper dataset id 'gd_l1viktl72bvl7bjuj0' with a LinkedIn profile URL as input.

The dataset flow spends real Bright Data credits (one Web Scraper collection) and waits 5 minutes for the snapshot to become ready; AfterAll timeout is 600 s. If a collection routinely needs longer, raise the Wait interval rather than the assert.

FindSnapshotRecords declares no schema-level required inputs on purpose: snapshotId feeds the component's own dynamic outPort source, and the e2e rule 'dynamic-source-static-input' rejects a required source input bound to a modifier. It is still enforced at run time with a CancelError.
Bright Data publishes no single hard rate limit; quota.js uses a conservative 10 requests/second sliding window. Revisit once real 429 behaviour is observed.
